key_findings: The historical MicroProse catalogue cannot be mapped to a single present-day rightsholder.
Civilization is an actively exploited 2K/Firaxis/Take-Two franchise in 2026 and must not be assigned to the revived MicroProse merely because MicroProse published the 1991 original.
Current MicroProse Software Pty Ltd actively exploits B-17 Flying Fortress heritage.
Historical MicroProse passed through Spectrum HoloByte, Hasbro Interactive and Infogrames/Atari, but individual IPs were subsequently split, transferred or separately licensed.
Spectrum HoloByte's historical Tetris publication does not imply ownership of the Tetris franchise today.
RGME Rights Intelligence needs a temporal rights graph.

architecture_finding.name: Temporal Rights Graph
architecture_finding.rule: Never infer current ownership merely by traversing an unqualified historical corporate chain.
